acip: NYAL LUGS PHYI MA LTAR BYED NA STONG NYID KYI NGANG LA NYAL BA THUGS KYI DAG PA STE 'CHI BA SBYONG, LHA SKUR LDANG BA SKU DAG PA STE SKYE BA SBYONG, BDUD RTZI MYANG BA 'OD DPAG MED GSUNG GI DAG PA STE LONGS SKU 'GRUB PA'I SMIN BYED DANG, 'DI'I DAG PA SBYOR TSUL SHIN TU LEGS TE 'OD GSAL DE LAS GZUGS SKUR BZHENGS TE, BZLAS BRJOD SOGS BYED PAS SO,,
wylie: nyal lugs phyi ma ltar byed na stong nyid kyi ngang la nyal ba thugs kyi dag pa ste 'chi ba sbyong, lha skur ldang ba sku dag pa ste skye ba sbyong, bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med gsung gi dag pa ste longs sku 'grub pa'i smin byed dang, 'di'i dag pa sbyor tshul shin tu legs te 'od gsal de las gzugs skur bzhengs te, bzlas brjod sogs byed pas so
english: Sleeping in the latter of the two ways--that is, dropping off to sleep within the void--is also the purity of Her holy mind, and acts to transform the state of death.  Getting out of bed in Her sacred form is the purity of Her holy body, and functions to transform the state of rebirth. Partaking of the nectar is the purity of the sacred speech of Limitless Light, and serves to ripen our minds for achieving the body of paradise.  This way of explaining what the three purities refer to is a very fine one, since we should be getting up out of a state of the clear light, rising in the holy body of an enlightened form, and then undertaking our various practices, such as recitation. The Categories of Practice
